question: Which international badminton player became world No. 1 in 2025, marking a first in his country’s history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kunlavut Vitidsarn**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kunlavut Vitidsarn** achieved a historic milestone by becoming the **World No. 1** in the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)** men’s singles rankings in **January 2025**.
 
• He is the **first-ever male singles player from Thailand** to reach the top spot in the global rankings, solidifying his status as a national sporting icon. ***Hence, the statement is correct.***
 
• His rise to the top was propelled by a series of high-profile successes, including winning the **silver medal** at the **2024 Paris Olympics**, where he reached the final after defeating top seeds.
